cohort: The study included postpartum women and their newborns from three maternity hospitals in the state of Espirito Santo, Brazil, with 2,325 mother/baby pairs at day 7 and 1,819 at day 27.
finding: The rates of exclusive breastfeeding were 80.7% at 7 days and 79.2% at 27 days, with maternal age up to 19 years, full-term birth, and no difficulty in EBF significantly influencing EBF practice.
